cases.normal: exact original live issuer + consumed original intent + durable full handle/start outcome; new view has no inherited freshness or Release authority
cases.fresh-health: actual new Query and later global sample sequence; public M3 hash/Argus schema valid; no duplicate started outcome
cases.staged: no durable full handle; cleanup-only with original C1, no Release
cases.history-loss: missing intent/consumption/outcome/mirror blocks ordinary reconstruction and starts; original cleanup independent
cases.issuer-loss: PID/path/new issuer cannot substitute; preserve unknown wait and cleanup facts
cases.conflict: nonblocking original owner/view/root conflicts reject before mutation; cancel independent
cases.scope: copied/new process/new host session and changed matching repeat reject
cases.limits: same-supervisor view reconstruction only; full cross-process recovery/global M1/U7/U8/admission not claimed
